【Breaking News】
Hololive 3rd Generation Members Unleash Chaos in Battle
description:
■About This Game
Hololive Fantasy, the unit featuring 〈Houshou Marine〉〈Shirogane Noel〉〈Shiranui Flare〉 and 〈Usada Pekora〉, enters the biggest free-for-all battle of the century in pursuit of the wish-granting “Queen’s Throne”!
Experience “oshi victory” by winning with your oshi in this 2.5D versus action game for up to four players!
That's ‘Hololive Fantasy Battle’ #HoloBattle

■How to Play
・[Move] → [Attack] That’s it!
・Use unique attacks to stagger opponents, knock them back, and gain the upper hand!
・Obtaining a Red Super Weapon drastically changes your attacks!
・Launch the game-changing “Solo Live,” and let your oshi dominate the stage!

■Costume Change
・Your oshi is already cute enough, but now they’ll become even cuter. Can you darlings handle it?!

■Versus Mode: "Online Battle"
・Up to 4 players clash in an all-out brawl to decide the winner!
・Expand your strategy with combinations of [Each Talent's Unique Ability] × [Field Gimmicks]!

■Solo / Co-op Mode: "Fake Hunter"
・For one reason or another, fake 3rd Gen members and fake 3rd Gen fans have appeared all over the place and are causing chaos. Time to make them reflect… ORAA!!
・Fight solo with NPC allies, or team up with friends and other players online!
・No worries if an ally goes down! With the "Rescue Totsumachi" feature, you can rescue fallen teammates—or have them rescue you.
